title: Vitamins A and E
what: This blood test shows whether your body has enough vitamins A and E.
why: For conditions where fat is poorly absorbed: bowel, liver, or pancreas problems, or after stomach surgery. Also for poor vision at dusk and dry skin.
duration: the blood draw takes a few minutes; results usually come in 1 to 2 weeks
tell_doctor: If you take vitamins or fish oil
If you have a bowel, liver, or pancreas condition
If you had stomach or bowel surgery

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: Usually on an empty stomach: 8 to 12 hours without food. It is especially important not to eat fatty food the day before. Water is fine.

prepare.title: Vitamins
prepare.text: Ask your doctor if you should pause your vitamins before the test.

prepare.title: The day before
prepare.text: For 24 hours: no alcohol and no hard workouts. Try not to smoke in the morning.

prepare.title: Clothing
prepare.text: A sleeve you can easily roll up above the elbow.

bring: Your referral or list of tests
A list of your vitamins and supplements
steps: You sit down and rest your arm on the armrest
A band is tied above your elbow, and you are asked to clench your fist a few times
The skin is wiped with antiseptic
A quick prick. Blood fills the tubes in a few seconds
The needle comes out, and a cotton pad is pressed on the spot
The tube is shielded from light, because light breaks down these vitamins
feel: A quick prick, like a pinch
Sometimes slight dizziness. Tell the nurse, and they will help you lie down
after: Press the cotton pad for 3 to 5 minutes
Do not take large doses of vitamins on your own. Too much is harmful too
red_flags: The puncture site is very swollen, painful, and red

faq.q: Why do results take so long?
faq.a: These vitamins are measured on special equipment that not every lab has. You will be told the timing when you give blood.

faq.q: Can I take vitamins to prevent problems without a test?
faq.a: Normal doses in multivitamins, if your doctor agrees. Large doses of vitamin A without a test are dangerous.

reminders.text: Vitamin A and E test tomorrow. No fatty dinner today, and do not eat after it. Water is fine.
